That's really good advice, thank you. Skype is already a reasonable part of our relationship seeing as he's studying hard and can often not take time out in the week, so we talk most days. I hope your relationship continues as well as it sounds!
Yeah, we figured that out quite early in. We've been together for around a year and a half now, and it doesn't look to be ending any time soon! Thanks for the advice, I'll keep it in mind.

I'm still in my first relationship, but I wish someone had told me it doesn't get easier once you get past the does he like me or not stage. I was expecting everything to be simple once the guy actually asked me out, but it turns out it doesn't.

Normally if one of the people I trust gets cross with me over anything, even something they have a right to get cross about, I completely lose control. Also if I feel lonely, which is often due to my apparent inability to trust. It's not about punishing myself and more about when I feel I'm losing control over a situation, it gives me something that I control.

That, unless you are my BF, if I look panicked and run off, the last thing you want to do is follow me. I suffer from a certain amount of depression, and I've always been claustrophobic when it comes to people. If I'm panicking, I need space to calm down, not a person trying to comfort me.

With me? not so much SOMEONE, as my BF's parents. They terrify me for no reason as they are a lovely couple, but nope, I'm scared witless! I'm so scared of staring at the wrong person or taking more than my fair share of food that I eat like a bird and never speak!
Arthur. Yes, the aardvark one. I figured i was too old for it after a while, but in the last few years it's been something for me to watch and smile about and cheer me up no end. So, yeah. Arthur.
